modeling_decisions: Concept visible inset single channel and alternating inside bars/outside cliffs retained. Generated output is one oblique view rather than requested compatible multiview; hidden surfaces resolved explicitly here: complete solid underside, side soil walls, continuous water surface with finite bed volume, channel runs -Y to+Y through three broad alternating bends. At positive-X bend apex inside bar on-X bank and outside cutbank on+X bank; reverse at negative-X bend. No sand on outside bend, no islands/lakes/trees. Opaque water, no transparency artifacts.
